# googleworkspace_group_settings (Resource)

Settings of a Google Workspace group, such as who can post, who can join, and whether people outside the organization can be members. Uses the Groups Settings API.

Only the settings set in configuration are managed; the rest are read so they show in state, and left as they are. Settings cannot be deleted, so destroying this resource only removes it from state, and the group keeps its current settings.

~> **Requirements:** the provider must use `service_account` (a pre-minted `access_token` cannot be used), the service account's domain-wide delegation must include the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/apps.groups.settings` scope, and the Groups Settings API must be enabled in its project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An access-only group: its membership grants access to the treasurer@ mailbox
# through Gmail delegation, so nobody should mail it or find it. The group has no
# owners, and ALL_OWNERS_CAN_POST lets only owners post. NONE_CAN_POST would need
# archive_only, which marks the group inactive.
resource "googleworkspace_group" "treasurer_delegates" {
  email       = "treasurer-delegates@example.org"
  name        = "Treasurer delegates"
  description = "Access list for treasurer@. Not a mailing list."
}

resource "googleworkspace_group_settings" "treasurer_delegates" {
  email = googleworkspace_group.treasurer_delegates.email

  who_can_post_message           = "ALL_OWNERS_CAN_POST"
  who_can_join                   = "INVITED_CAN_JOIN"
  who_can_discover_group         = "ALL_MEMBERS_CAN_DISCOVER"
  allow_external_members         = false
  include_in_global_address_list = false
}

# A mailing list that forwards to people outside the organization, replacing a
# Gmail routing rule.
resource "googleworkspace_group_settings" "hiking" {
  email = "hiking@example.org"

  who_can_post_message     = "ANYONE_CAN_POST"
  message_moderation_level = "MODERATE_NON_MEMBERS"
  allow_external_members   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Primary email of the group, e.g. `googleworkspace_group.example.email`.

### Optional

- `allow_external_members` (Boolean) Whether people outside the organization can be members. Workspace must also allow external members for the organization (Admin console > Apps > Google Groups for Business).
- `allow_web_posting` (Boolean) Whether members can post from the Google Groups web interface, not only by email.
- `archive_only` (Boolean) Makes the group read-only: new messages are rejected and `who_can_post_message` becomes `NONE_CAN_POST`. Turning it off resets `who_can_post_message` to `ALL_MANAGERS_CAN_POST`.
- `enable_collaborative_inbox` (Boolean) Whether the group is a collaborative inbox, where members can take, assign, and resolve conversations. Google requires conversation history (`is_archived`) for collaborative inbox features ([Make a group a Collaborative Inbox](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/10375787)). The Groups Settings API reference does not say whether it rejects `true` while `is_archived` is false, so the plan warns about that combination instead of failing.
- `include_in_global_address_list` (Boolean) Whether the group appears in the Global Address List and in address autocomplete.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether messages sent to the group are kept in its web archive.
- `members_can_post_as_the_group` (Boolean) Whether members can send mail with the group's address as the sender.
- `message_moderation_level` (String) Which messages wait for a moderator before delivery. One of `MODERATE_ALL_MESSAGES`, `MODERATE_NON_MEMBERS`, `MODERATE_NEW_MEMBERS`, `MODERATE_NONE`.
- `spam_moderation_level` (String) What happens to messages flagged as spam. One of `ALLOW`, `MODERATE`, `SILENTLY_MODERATE`, `REJECT`.
- `who_can_contact_owner` (String) Who can email the group's owners. One of `ALL_IN_DOMAIN_CAN_CONTACT`, `ALL_MANAGERS_CAN_CONTACT`, `ALL_MEMBERS_CAN_CONTACT`, `ANYONE_CAN_CONTACT`.
- `who_can_discover_group` (String) Who can find the group in the groups directory. One of `ANYONE_CAN_DISCOVER`, `ALL_IN_DOMAIN_CAN_DISCOVER`, `ALL_MEMBERS_CAN_DISCOVER`.
- `who_can_join` (String) Who can join the group. `ANYONE_CAN_JOIN` includes people outside the organization. One of `ANYONE_CAN_JOIN`, `ALL_IN_DOMAIN_CAN_JOIN`, `INVITED_CAN_JOIN`, `CAN_REQUEST_TO_JOIN`.
- `who_can_leave_group` (String) Who can leave the group on their own. One of `ALL_MANAGERS_CAN_LEAVE`, `ALL_MEMBERS_CAN_LEAVE`, `NONE_CAN_LEAVE`.
- `who_can_moderate_content` (String) Who can approve, delete, and move messages. One of `ALL_MEMBERS`, `OWNERS_AND_MANAGERS`, `OWNERS_ONLY`, `NONE`.
- `who_can_moderate_members` (String) Who can add, remove, approve, and ban members. One of `ALL_MEMBERS`, `OWNERS_AND_MANAGERS`, `OWNERS_ONLY`, `NONE`.
- `who_can_post_message` (String) Who can send mail to the group. `NONE_CAN_POST` is only accepted while `archive_only` is true, and setting `archive_only` sets it. One of `NONE_CAN_POST`, `ALL_MANAGERS_CAN_POST`, `ALL_MEMBERS_CAN_POST`, `ALL_OWNERS_CAN_POST`, `ALL_IN_DOMAIN_CAN_POST`, `ANYONE_CAN_POST`.
- `who_can_view_group` (String) Who can read the group's conversations. One of `ANYONE_CAN_VIEW`, `ALL_IN_DOMAIN_CAN_VIEW`, `ALL_MEMBERS_CAN_VIEW`, `ALL_MANAGERS_CAN_VIEW`, `ALL_OWNERS_CAN_VIEW`.
- `who_can_view_membership` (String) Who can see the member list. One of `ALL_IN_DOMAIN_CAN_VIEW`, `ALL_MEMBERS_CAN_VIEW`, `ALL_MANAGERS_CAN_VIEW`, `ALL_OWNERS_CAN_VIEW`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The group's email address. Used for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Group settings are imported by the group's email address.
terraform import googleworkspace_group_settings.treasurer_delegates treasurer-delegates@example.org
```
